content.title: THE 10-MINUTE CHEAT SHEET FOR A {{BETTER}} DAY
facts: **Walking** -> 20 min after dinner -> Flattens sugar spike
**Cold water** -> 1 glass right after waking -> Kickstarts alertness
**Deep breathing** -> 5 min before bed -> Lowers stress hormone
**Stretching** -> 5 min every morning -> Loosens stiff joints
**Journaling** -> 3 sentences at night -> Quiets racing thoughts
**Phone-free time** -> 30 min before bed -> Deepens sleep quality
**Fresh air** -> 2x/day, 5 min each -> Clears mental fog
**Follow along** – for more simple daily habits like this.
content.caption:
A few of these are easier to pull off than you'd think. **Sunlight** within the first hour of waking tells your brain to stop producing melatonin, which is why it makes falling asleep that night so much easier. A short **walk** after dinner works because your muscles pull glucose straight from your bloodstream to use as fuel, so less of it lingers and spikes. And **cold water** first thing in the morning jolts your nervous system awake faster than coffee does, since the temperature shock alone raises alertness before caffeine even kicks in. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so notice what actually moves the needle for you.
